title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-126-25二模

items.zh: 她的行李箱里塞满了纪念品,结果超重了。
items.en: Her suitcase was stuffed with so many souvenirs that it was overweight.

items.zh: 该公司在人工智能领域的成就和影响力不容小觑。
items.en: The company’s achievements and influence in the field of AI should not be taken lightly.

items.zh: 这家餐厅成功地将传统烹饪技艺融入现代国际美食中,创造出独特的风味。
items.en: The restaurant successfully integrates traditional cooking techniques into modern international cuisine, creating a unique flavor.

items.zh: 中国古诗词以其优美的韵律、丰富的意象和深刻的哲理,至今仍被广泛传颂和学习。
items.en: With graceful rhythm, rich imagery and profound philosophy, ancient Chinese poetry is still widely read and studied today.
